summary.text: Dave Rutigliano has represented Connecticut's 123rd House District since 2013 and is the Republican candidate for the seat on the November 3, 2026 ballot.

paragraphs.text: He holds an associate degree in restaurant, culinary and catering from Johnson & Wales University.
He has owned and operated small businesses for more than 18 years and is a former member of the Trumbull Board of Finance and the Trumbull Economic Development Commission.
